## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, …; `!` for breaking changes)
- [ ] `bun run check` passes locally (format, lint, typecheck, tests, package check, smoke)
- [ ] Tests added or updated for behaviour changes
- [ ] README / CONTRIBUTING updated if commands, options, configuration or exit codes changed
- [ ] No tokens, personal configuration or `.env` content in code, tests, fixtures or screenshots
